disclosures.text: Device for loading a washing machine with components to be washed
Device comprising a perimeter frame
Abutment means positioned within the perimeter defined by the frame
Abutment means adapted to house components in a predetermined position
Apparatus for handling a device according to claims 1-6
Apparatus comprises handling means adapted to move the device
Handling means move the device from the exit to the entrance of a tunnel washing machine
Device for loading a washing machine with components to be washed, comprising a perimeter frame and abutment means within the frame adapted to house components in a predetermined position
Apparatus for handling a device, comprising handling means adapted to move the device from the exit of a tunnel washing machine to its entrance
Abutment means comprise a plurality of supports fixed to the frame
A plurality of abutments are movably positioned on the supports
Supports comprise longitudinal and transverse bars
Bars are reversibly fixed to the frame, forming a modular system
At least some abutments are slidingly associated with transverse bars
Abutments comprise notches in an upper portion
Notches adapted to removably house components
Frame and abutment means are made of stainless steel
Apparatus further comprises a first tilting device at the washing machine entrance
First tilting device picks up the device from handling means and deposits it onto a loading station
Apparatus further comprises a second tilting device at the washing machine exit
Second tilting device picks up the device from an unloading station and couples it with handling means
Apparatus further comprises a loading station at the washing machine entrance
Loading station houses the device for loading operations
Apparatus further comprises an unloading station at the washing machine exit
Unloading station houses the device for unloading operations
Handling means comprise a chain conveyor device
Loading station and unloading station comprise a roller conveyor
Each roller conveyor comprises lifting means
Lifting means maintain the device in a raised and indexed position
